paragraphs: This is the same gasket pattern rendered in brass rather than steel, and the material change is not cosmetic in a catalogue: composite and metal gaskets look different, age differently and are specified for different rebuilds. Showing both lets a parts listing be honest about what is being sold.
The mesh is 24,338 polygons and 12,067 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, with the geometry in the fire rings and the passage cutouts that identify the part.
At $19 it suits automotive parts marketing and catalogues, engine technical illustration, workshop and rebuild scenes, training material and games. On sale since 2023.
